orientation_sign.speaker: EMC Guide
orientation_sign.prompt_content: Read a short introduction to the EMC campus.
orientation_sign.text: Welcome to the EMC campus. Follow the path to explore the Animation, Game Development, and Multimedia laboratories.

terminal_welcome.speaker: Orientation Terminal
terminal_welcome.prompt_content: Use this terminal to begin your campus orientation.
terminal_welcome.text: Your first task is to explore the campus and interact with its learning stations.

library_door_locked.speaker: Laboratory Door
library_door_locked.text: This door is locked. Complete the Orientation Terminal first.

collectible_badge.speaker: Achievement
collectible_badge.prompt_content: Pick up this glowing Explorer Badge.
collectible_badge.text: You found an EMC Explorer Badge!

npc_campus_guide.speaker: Mika
npc_campus_guide.prompt_content: Talk to Mika for instructions on how to begin your EMC campus tour.
npc_campus_guide.text: Hi! Start by reading the orientation terminal, then visit the campus sign and Animation Laboratory.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Hi Mika, how do I begin the campus tour?

dialogue.speaker: Mika
dialogue.text: Would you like a quick overview or should I explain everything step by step?

dialogue.speaker: Mika
dialogue.text: Each station introduces a different part of Entertainment and Multimedia Computing.

npc_kyle_coding.speaker: Kyle
npc_kyle_coding.prompt_content: Talk to Kyle about the Coding Laboratory.
npc_kyle_coding.text: Welcome to the Coding Lab! This is where you learn to bring ideas to life through code.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Hey Kyle, what happens in the Coding Lab?

dialogue.speaker: Kyle
dialogue.text: This is where we teach programming for games, apps, and interactive media.

dialogue.speaker: Kyle
dialogue.text: You'll learn languages like C#, Python, and GDScript. Ready to start coding?

npc_carl_animation.speaker: Carl
npc_carl_animation.prompt_content: Talk to Carl about the Animation Studio.
npc_carl_animation.text: The Animation Studio is where characters and worlds come alive!

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Hi Carl, what's the Animation Studio all about?

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: We teach 2D and 3D animation, motion graphics, and visual effects.

dialogue.speaker: Carl
dialogue.text: From hand-drawn frame-by-frame to rigging and skeletal animation — it's all here.

npc_brix_3d.speaker: Brix
npc_brix_3d.prompt_content: Talk to Brix about the 3D Design Laboratory.
npc_brix_3d.text: Welcome to the 3D Design Lab! Let's sculpt, model, and texture.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Hey Brix, what do you teach here?

dialogue.speaker: Brix
dialogue.text: 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, and rendering. Blender, Maya, you name it.

dialogue.speaker: Brix
dialogue.text: Every great game and movie starts with solid 3D assets. Want to try making one?

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Yes! I've always wanted to create 3D characters.

npc_sheon_gamedev.speaker: Sheon
npc_sheon_gamedev.prompt_content: Talk to Sheon about the Game Development Laboratory.
npc_sheon_gamedev.text: Welcome to the Game Dev Lab! This is where everything comes together.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: Hi Sheon, what's special about Game Dev?

dialogue.speaker: Sheon
dialogue.text: Game Dev combines programming, art, audio, and design into one experience.

dialogue.speaker: Sheon
dialogue.text: You'll learn game engines, level design, physics, and player psychology.

dialogue.speaker: Player
dialogue.text: This is exactly what I want to do!
